title: Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement Account Settlement Terms and Payment Fees
content:
Accounts receivable settles each stay account of the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement on the figures below: when the final balance falls due, the fee if it stays unpaid, the fee for a returned payment, the convenience fee on card payments and the time within which a credit balance is refunded.

## Settlement figures by stay type

| Stay type | Final balance due (calendar days after check-out) | Late payment fee (USD, one time) | Returned payment fee (USD) | Card convenience fee (percent of the payment) | Credit balance refunded within (calendar days after check-out or cancellation) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Independent Living Trial Stay | 15 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 2.9 | 14 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Standard Care) | 15 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 2.9 | 14 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Enhanced Care) | 15 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 2.9 | 14 |
| Assisted Living Respite Stay (Extensive Care) | 15 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 2.9 | 14 |
| Memory Care Respite Stay | 15 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 2.9 | 14 |
| Post-Hospital Recovery Stay | 15 | 50.00 | 35.00 | 2.9 | 14 |

## Meaning of each figure

- **Final balance due** — the stay balance must be paid within this many calendar days after check-out.
- **Late payment fee** — a one-time fee when the stay balance remains unpaid after the final-balance period.
- **Returned payment fee** — the fee of the stay type for a returned payment.
- **Card convenience fee** — the convenience fee on a credit card payment, as a percent of the payment.
- **Refund period** — the number of calendar days after check-out or cancellation by which a credit balance is refunded.

## Hypothetical illustration

A hypothetical credit card payment of 1,000.00 on a stay carries a convenience fee at 2.9 percent of the payment, 29.00. Every stay type uses the same settlement figures, so the stay type does not change any figure in this table.
